name: Hybrid Greedy/Regular 2D Packing
aliases: Hybrid Greedy/Regular 2D Packing for Volume Rendering
definition: A hybrid CPU-GPU pipeline that partitions a 3D volume into non-empty bounding boxes, packs them into 2D texture slices, and optionally applies post-packing rotation to minimize memory overhead for volume rendering.
summary: Hybrid Greedy/Regular 2D Packing partitions 3D volumes into 2D texture slices, dynamically choosing greedy or regular packing based on sparsity to minimize memory overhead.
